name: Clay Magouyrk

career.title: Founding member of the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure engineering team; various roles
Executive Vice President, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Engineering / Cloud Infrastructure
Chief Executive Officer (co-CEO with Mike Sicilia)

background_rationale: An electrical engineer who worked as a senior engineer at AWS and then helped build and lead Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's engineering team before becoming co-CEO.

notable.summary: On being named co-CEO alongside Mike Sicilia, succeeding Safra Catz, the pair said they were "excited to lead Oracle into the AI era."

Reporting quarterly results with remaining performance obligations of $523 billion, Magouyrk said Oracle had 211 live and planned cloud regions and that its multicloud database business grew 817% in the quarter.
Oracle named Hilary Maxson as chief financial officer, with Magouyrk citing a fit with Oracle's "culture of strong financial and operational discipline."
Oracle reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $19.3 billion, up 30%, with cloud infrastructure revenue up 121% and remaining performance obligations of $664 billion.

personal_story.hook: Clay Magouyrk left a senior engineering job at AWS for Oracle in 2014; eleven years later, at 39, he became co-CEO.
personal_story.summary: Magouyrk studied electrical engineering at the University of Memphis and spent six years at Amazon and Amazon Web Services as an engineer. He joined Oracle in 2014 as a founding member of the team that built Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, overseeing the design and rollout of its second-generation cloud. He became president of OCI in June 2025 and three months later, at 39, was named co-CEO of Oracle alongside Mike Sicilia.
